cues.en: Our next speaker is Doug Zonker. Doug wrote an article, which we published in the handles not too long ago. And I don't feel, although I think I'm not bad as a writer or as an editor, I do not feel capable of summarizing this article. That's why I asked Doug to present it to you soon.
cues.zh: 我们的下一位讲者是 Doug Zonker。Doug 之前写过一篇文章，前不久刚发表在我们的专栏上。虽然我觉得自己写文章和做编辑还行，但我真觉得没法给这篇文章做总结。所以我就请 Doug 亲自来为大家做个介绍。
